svg.aria-label: How SwiftLM runs a feature: Describe, a versioned contract says what the feature asks; Fit, sources are packed into the model's token budget; Route, the first model that can honor the request answers; Check, output is checked against the sources; Record, a redacted receipt says what ran and why; then evaluation cases replay the feature when a prompt or a model changes.
